audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[].side read 'Skill' while content win[] read Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand/Malzahar/Brand/Malzahar — exactly the packet levelChart. The full layer never carried either of the two Malzahar rows.
audit.why: Packet and content agree on both dips: level 6 for Nether Grasp and the 2+ item row where his suppression still picks a target out of every fight.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side = Brand, phases[4].side = Malzahar, phases[5].side = Brand, phases[6].side = Malzahar, with phases[4].why and phases[6].why rewritten so both sentences match their flipped rows.

audit.why: Malzahar's spike is level 6 at 140s, and it sharpens hard at rank 3 where Nether Grasp drops to 80s — that is what makes the late row his rather than yours. Brand's are level 3, level 6 and Liandry's.
audit.corrected: Put the 140s/80s numbers into breakdown.cooldowns and phases[6].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Void Shift was described twice as a 'passive shield'. It is not a shield — it is massive damage reduction plus crowd-control immunity that holds until he takes damage. While it is up your Sear stun does nothing at all, which is the single most important fact in this matchup and appeared nowhere on the page. Also absent: Nether Grasp is a channel, so a Sear stun cancels it outright; and Call of the Void silences on a flat 6s at 900 range.
audit.why: All three are in Riot's text verbatim — the passive's CC immunity, R's channel tag, Q's silence.
audit.corrected: Rewrote winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and four bullets around Void Shift, the channel cancel and the silence.

audit.why: Nether Grasp 140/110/80s, Call of the Void a flat 6s, Void Swarm a flat 8s, Malefic Visions 11/10/9/8/7s.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with the R and Q numbers and the window each opens.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text referenced 'Null Zone' as one of Malzahar's abilities. There is no ability by that name in his kit — his slots are Void Shift, Call of the Void, Void Swarm, Malefic Visions and Nether Grasp.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name on a paid page is the exact defect class this audit exists to remove.
audit.corrected: Removed it and grounded the spike in Malefic Visions plus the Void Shift strip.

edits.before: Out-burn the spell war and stun the answer — the ledger always reads Blaze. Nothing here works through Nether Grasp — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Chip Void Shift off him before you commit — while it holds he is CC-immune and your stun does nothing. Nether Grasp is 140s at rank 1, and Sear cancels the channel.

edits.before: Malzahar wins by landing Nether Grasp, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Malzahar wins by silencing you with Call of the Void, then suppressing you with Nether Grasp while Void Shift eats your answer.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while Void Shift is intact — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E-Q stun package for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp: 140s at rank 1 and 80s at rank 3 — the longest cooldown in the lane, so the minute after he spends it belongs to you. - Call of the Void is a flat 6s silence at 900 range, and Void Shift re-arms itself the moment you stop chipping him.

edits.before: Good trade: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt. Bad trade: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: Good trade: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt. Bad trade: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while Void Shift is intact — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.

edits.before: Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Void Shift gives him damage reduction and CC immunity until you damage him — a Pillar on his farming spot is what strips it off.

edits.before: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt.
edits.after: Conflagration is point-and-click at 625, so it lands through his Voidlings and arms Sear's stun with no skillshot to dodge.

edits.before: Malzahar spends Nether Grasp early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Sear cancels Nether Grasp outright — it is a channel, and any stun ends it.

edits.before: That is Malzahar’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Sear costs 70 mana and only stuns a target already ablaze.

edits.before: Your stun only exists on ablaze targets — a Q thrown at a clean health bar is the most expensive miss in your kit.
edits.after: Call of the Void is a flat 6s and it silences, so caught in a cooldown gap you cannot even start the E-Q package.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: Void Shift's damage reduction is at its strongest before you have touched him, so the opener is the worst place to dump the rotation.

edits.before: Track Malzahar’s Nether Grasp: Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Void Shift as well as Nether Grasp: it is damage reduction plus CC immunity, not a shield, and it makes your stun useless until you chip it off him.

edits.before: Pillar of Flame plus Conflagration out-trades his Malefic Visions/Null Zone poke because your combo hits instantly while his DoT needs time to ramp, letting you win short trades before his damage ticks up.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame plus Conflagration out-trades his Malefic Visions poke because your combo lands instantly while his DoT ramps, and every tick you land also strips Void Shift straight off him.

notes: The 'execute-threshold' missing interaction is a flag misfire: Riot's text for Malefic Visions says that if the target dies while afflicted the visions PASS ON to a nearby unit — that is spread, not a health-threshold execute. There is no HP number to track, so I wrote nothing about it rather than invent one.
